content:
If you like the new wallpapers Apple designed for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, you don't need to buy a new iPhone to use them. You can download them right here.

Download the all-new iPhone 18 Pro wallpapers

Although the default iOS wallpapers are dynamic and react to your device's movement and actions, the versions below are still images captured directly from the first iOS 27 Release Candidate.

It seems the Release Candidate doesn't include the iPhone Duo wallpapers, so you may have to wait a few more weeks — possibly until iOS 27.1.

Remember to tap or click on the images to save the full-resolution wallpapers. If you're using an iOS device, you can set them as your background through the Photos app or the Settings app.

To see 9to5Mac's full coverage of Apple's "Surprise and Shine" event, click this link.

Do you have a favorite pick? Let us know in the comments.
